item.title: Under the Hood: Deconstructing AiAgent Architectures for Autonomous Systems
item.description: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has ushered in a new era of intelligent automation, culminating in the rise of AiAgents. More than just wrappers around LLMs, AiAgents represent a paradigm shift towards autonomous, goal-oriented systems capable of perception, reasoning, action, and continuous learning within dynamic environments. This deep-dive post, tailored for the DataFibers Community, will peel back the layers, exploring the architectural patterns, “under-the-hood” mechanics, and practical implementation challenges of building robust AiAgents.
